title: Work conditions in focus / 工作条件回顾

interpretations.headline: Put workload and available time on the same page / 工作量要和可用时间放在一起看
interpretations.summary:
This result reflects workload, pace, conflicting demands and opportunities for breaks. A higher mean indicates relatively fewer difficulties in these working conditions over the recall period. If new urgent tasks regularly displace breaks and pre-existing commitments, noting which demands overlap can make an otherwise vague concern easier to discuss.

任务数量、速度、休息时机和不易兼顾的要求，都可能让工作显得拥挤。这个维度越高，表示你在回顾期内报告这些困难相对较少。

比如，同一天多了两件急事，原计划中的工作仍要求按时交付，连休息都被挤掉。回顾是哪几个要求同时出现，往往比只记录“今天很累”更有信息。

guidance.text:
Pick one recurring overlap. Record the deadlines and actual time available, then clarify priorities or possible adjustments with the person who can coordinate the work.

找一个经常重叠的任务组合，记录各自时限和可用时间。条件允许时，与能安排工作的人核对优先次序，看看哪一项可以延后或分担。

interpretations.scoreLabel: Demands / 工作要求（1–5 分均分）

interpretations.headline: Identify the decisions you can make in practice / 在现有安排里找得到的选择
interpretations.summary:
This result describes the practical choices available about pace, timing, methods, sequencing and breaks. Higher scores reflect more reported room to decide. A deadline may be fixed while the order of steps or the way to organise the task remains open to choice. Distinguishing those two constraints can guide a useful conversation.

这个维度关注你在速度、方法、顺序和休息等方面能否作一些实际选择。较高分数表示报告较多有选择的空间。

同样是一项限时工作，有时可以决定先做哪一部分，也可能需要全程遵循固定步骤。两种场景的任务相同，可协商的空间并不一样。

guidance.text:
Name one decision you already make and one you can discuss. Start with a specific change, such as setting aside a short block of uninterrupted time.

标出一件你可以自行安排的事和一件需要协商的事。先从可以明确边界的那一步着手，例如争取一段少被打断的工作时间。

interpretations.scoreLabel: Control / 工作自主空间（1–5 分均分）

interpretations.headline: Check whether useful support arrives when needed / 需要的支持能不能及时到位
interpretations.summary:
This result describes whether you report receiving useful feedback, encouragement and help with difficult work. It reflects the support available to you in practice. When two deadlines collide, a clear decision on priority can be more useful than general reassurance. Other situations may call for timely feedback or practical resources.

这里记录能否得到有用的反馈、鼓励以及处理棘手问题时的帮助。结果描述你接触到的支持条件和体验。

当两项要求约在同一时间，协调优先次序可能就是当下最需要的帮助。具体反馈与安排资源也分别解决不同的问题。

guidance.text:
Turn the broad request into a specific one: a decision, useful feedback or someone to coordinate a conflict. If raising it directly feels difficult, first check what support routes are available.

把需要说具体，例如某项决定、一次反馈或谁负责协调何事。选择合适渠道；担心后果时，可以先向可信的支持者了解可行选项。

interpretations.scoreLabel: Managerial Support / 管理者支持（1–5 分均分）

interpretations.headline: Notice what colleagues can share or take over / 遇到难处，手边有没有可以接力的人
interpretations.summary:
This result concerns practical help, listening and respect from colleagues. Access to peer support may change with staffing, shifts and allocation of duties. Talking through a problem with a colleague can help in a different way from handing over one urgent task. Naming the type of help makes the next conversation clearer.

这里回顾同事是否会帮忙、倾听和尊重彼此。较高均分表示比较常感到有同事支持；轮班、人员和分工也会影响互助机会。

一位同事愿意听你梳理一个难题，另一位帮你接过一项限时任务。这些支持的形式不一样，都值得准确说出来。

guidance.text:
Agree on one bounded form of mutual help, such as a short handover when work is busy. If staffing is the persistent issue, raise the allocation of work with someone who can coordinate it.

找一个边界清楚、双方都可以说不的小协作，例如约定忙时的交接办法。若限制来自持续的人手不足，可以把安排问题交给有权协调的人处理。

interpretations.scoreLabel: Peer Support / 同事支持（1–5 分均分）

interpretations.headline: A mean can capture only part of what happened / 问卷平均分只能记录一部分经历
interpretations.summary:
This result concerns strained relationships, conflict and inappropriate behaviour. A higher mean reflects fewer reported difficulties overall. A serious single event still deserves attention. Many routine interactions may be fine while one incident feels unsafe. An average cannot determine what happened or what support would be appropriate.

关系分记录你报告的紧张、冲突、不当对待等体验。较高均分表示这些经历在作答中相对较少；一次严重经历仍值得认真对待。

多数日子相处顺畅，也可能有一件让人感到不安全的事。一个均分无法说明事件怎样发生，也无法决定需要什么支持。

guidance.text:
If inappropriate behaviour occurs, prioritise your safety and choose a trusted or suitable organisational support route. Find out how confidentiality and follow-up work before deciding what to share.

如果发生不当对待，优先考虑安全，选择可信或合适的组织支持渠道。可以先了解对方如何处理保密和后续，再决定愿意分享哪些信息。

interpretations.scoreLabel: Relationships / 工作人际关系（1–5 分均分）

interpretations.headline: Clarify duties, aims and priorities / 把职责、目标和优先顺序说清楚
interpretations.summary:
This result concerns how clearly work expectations, responsibilities and the links to team goals are understood. If two people set different tasks as the highest priority, the practical issue may be an unclear route for resolving the conflict. Setting out the two requests can identify who needs to decide.

这里看工作要求和职责分工是否清楚，也包括你能否了解自己的工作和所在团队目标有什么关系。

两个负责人都把各自的任务列为最优先时，关键往往是缺一个明确的定夺渠道。问题写清楚之后，才知道应该请谁澄清。

guidance.text:
For one unclear task, check four details: the deliverable, deadline, responsible person and who makes the decision when requests conflict.

对一件容易说不清的任务确认四个信息：交付内容、期限、负责人和需求冲突时的决策者。必要时请相关人确认同一版安排。

interpretations.scoreLabel: Role / 角色清晰（1–5 分均分）

interpretations.headline: Find out what changes and where to ask / 变化怎样发生，有没有地方问清楚
interpretations.summary:
This result covers opportunities to ask questions, be consulted and understand how changes will be put into practice. Knowing that a process will change next week is different from knowing when it starts, how responsibilities shift and where to take questions.

这个维度关注工作变化发生时，能否提问、能否参与讨论，以及能否了解怎么落实。题目反映的是沟通与参与条件。

知道“下周流程会变”和知道“从哪天起由谁负责、遇到情况找谁”提供的信息不同。前者是通知，后者才让安排可以落实。

guidance.text:
Write down the one practical uncertainty that affects your work most. Ask about timing, roles or transition arrangements through a route that is appropriate for the situation.

记下最影响工作的一个具体问题，可从时间、分工或过渡方式中选择。通过合适渠道确认，保留暂时说不清的部分。

interpretations.scoreLabel: Change / 变动沟通（1–5 分均分）

limitations:
The seven means range from 1 to 5 and higher values reflect more favourable reported work conditions. Each mean uses all items in its own group. The reporting period is the previous six months. There is no overall score.

七项分别取 1–5 分均分，越高表示自述的条件相对有利。每项题组答全才计算该项，回顾范围是过去六个月。七项各自呈现。

This is optional individual reflection. The HSE organisational method uses anonymous group-level results alongside worker consultation and other evidence.

这份报告供本人整理经历。HSE 原组织流程使用匿名组级结果，并结合员工讨论和其他证据评估工作场所条件。

The source instrument is in English. The parallel Chinese copy is explanatory feedback.

英文本为原题，中文内容为随报告附上的解读。
来源为英国健康与安全执行局 HSE 的公开量表材料，遵从 Open Government Licence 的署名要求。
report.disclaimer: For personal reflection about work conditions only. / 用于回顾自己的工作条件。同事之间可以有不同经历，个人均分无法代表部门、单位或学校。
